messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: build broken due to assignments_double_var.cpp
parts:
My build is busted and it looks like the culprit is this function

void constrained_param_names(std::vector<std::string>& param_names__);

in this (apparently auto-generated) file:

src/test/gm/model_specs/compiled/assignments_double_var.cpp

The variable param_name_stream__ keeps getting declared in the
same scope. As in:

void constrained_param_names(std::vector<std::string>& param_names__) {
*** std::stringstream param_name_stream__;
param_name_stream__ << "tx";
param_names__.push_back(param_name_stream__.str());
for (int k_0__ = 1; k_0__ <= 5; ++k_0__) {
param_name_stream__ << "ty" << '.' << k_0__;
}
param_names__.push_back(param_name_stream__.str());
*** std::stringstream param_name_stream__;
for (int k_0__ = 1; k_0__ <= 6; ++k_0__) {
param_name_stream__ << "tz" << '.' << k_0__;
}
param_names__.push_back(param_name_stream__.str());
*** std::stringstream param_name_stream__;
for (int k_0__ = 1; k_0__ <= 5; ++k_0__) {
for (int k_1__ = 1; k_1__ <= 6; ++k_1__) {
param_name_stream__ << "tm" << '.' << k_0__ << '.' << k_1__;
}
}
param_names__.push_back(param_name_stream__.str());
*** std::stringstream param_name_stream__;
for (int k_0__ = 1; k_0__ <= 2; ++k_0__) {
param_name_stream__ << "tx1" << '.' << k_0__;
}
param_names__.push_back(param_name_stream__.str());
*** std::stringstream param_name_stream__;

....

- Bob
